messages:
Maria (AE): Quick sync — Acme wants a 4-week trial. They need clear acceptance criteria and a recommended model/infra plan. Can we draft?
Jamal (SE): Sure. High level Qs: 1) avg doc length / max context? 2) endpoint latency SLOs? 3) will they use tool-calling or only generation+retrieval?
Sarah (Acme PM): Ave user session is ~6 docs, ~10k tokens total typical, but some legal docs hit 60k tokens in a single request. We plan to chunk. Need embeddings for retrieval + a reranker.
Maria (AE): They also asked about function/tool calling for citation lookups and a PDF extractor.
Jamal (SE): Ok — recommended stack: - Retriever with 8k-context embed window for indexing + chunking strategy - Reranker model (smaller cross-encoder) for top-100 -> top-5 MMR re-rank - Generation model: 32k context variant for any single-request long-context needs, fallback 8k for cost.
Jamal (SE): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Precision@5 >= 0.75 on 50 canonical queries (customer eval set) 2) Latency: 95p < 600ms for rerank, 95p < 900ms for generation in hosted tier 3) PDF extractor + toolcall success >= 95% on sample set
Olivia (CSM): Suggest adding business metric: user task completion uplift >= 15% in the trial cohort vs baseline. Also define observability hooks we'll need: per-route token breakdown, retrieval hit rate, rerank scores.
Sarah (Acme PM): 15% uplift sounds reasonable. Can you also quantify cost estimate for 10k daily active users with mixed short+long requests?
Jamal (SE): Rough back-of-envelope: - Embeddings + retrieval: ~ $0.02 / 1k queries - Reranker (cross-encoder on smaller GPU): depends on batching, estimate $0.12 per 1k re-ranks - Generation (32k variant): ~ $0.35 per 1k tokens produced — these are placeholder numbers, we’ll refine with actual token profiles.
Nate (Security): Quick blockers from our side: data residency (must stay in eu-west-1), KMS-managed keys, SOC2 evidence, and a short answers security questionnaire. Also confirm that any PII in PDF extractor remains in dedicated namespace and isn't used to train models.
Maria (AE): Good call — Acme required eu-west-1. We should propose Dedicated or Private for trial?
Jamal (SE): For eu-west-1 + isolation I'd recommend Redwood Dedicated reserved pool for the trial (30-day), with autoscaler config to allow bursts. If they need on-prem later, we can prototype Private.
Jamal (SE): Example rollout config for the trial routes:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: acme-retrieval
    model: embed-medium
    region: eu-west-1
    cache: prefix
  - name: acme-rerank
    model: rerank-small
    region: eu-west-1
    min_replicas: 2
  - name: acme-gen
    model: gen-32k-v1
    region: eu-west-1
    fallback: gen-8k-v1
    latency_slo_ms: 900
```
Jamal (SE): We'll also add prefix KV caching for recurring prefixes to cut costs.
deploy-bot: Autoscaling policy "acme-trial" created (eu-west-1) :rocket:
Olivia (CSM): Timeline check: Week 0 - kickoff & security paperwork, Week 1 - infra + ingest sample corpus, Week 2 - run evals + tuning, Week 3 - user pilot + metric collection, Week 4 - wrap + contract decision.
Sarah (Acme PM): That timeline works. For the evals—I'll share 50 queries and 200 sample docs by Friday. Also can you add a quick on-call rotation for trial days?
Maria (AE): Yep. Jamal, Nate, Olivia — can each take one week of on-call support? We can rotate.
Nate (Security): I can cover week 1 for compliance onboarding and the security questionnaire. Need the questionnaire draft by EOD to pre-fill controls.
Jamal (SE): I'll own week 2/3 for tuning and run the eval harness. Please send the query set as CSV. My eval checklist: recall@5, mrr, hallucination rate (manual spot checks), latency percentiles.
Olivia (CSM): I'll instrument dashboards and set alerts: retrieval hit rate < 60% alert, latency 95p breach, cost burn > 20% over forecast.
Maria (AE): Action items: 1) Jamal: model/infra estimate + refined cost after sample docs (due Tue) 2) Nate: prefill security answers + residency confirmation (due Mon) 3) Olivia: dashboard template + alerts (due Tue) 4) Sarah: upload eval set + sample docs (due Fri)
Sarah (Acme PM): Will do. Thanks all — excited to get started. :raised_hands:
Maria (AE): Thanks — I'll update the SOW draft with these acceptance criteria and timeline and share with legal.
Nate (Security): Quick note re: training: we'll require a contract clause that prohibits using trial data for training. I'll draft the clause.
Jamal (SE): One more: if we see >10% of requests exceed 32k after chunking, we should plan a pre-emptive strategy (summarization or chunk stitching) — call it out in POC playbook.
Olivia (CSM): Noted. I'll include that mitigation in the playbook.
Maria (AE): Great thread. I'll circle back once SOW + cost est are in.
